subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.prompt:
Which cell part controls what moves in and out of the cell?
A) Nucleus
B) Cell membrane
C) Mitochondria
D) Vacuole

steps: The cell membrane is selectively permeable and controls movement in and out.

items.prompt:
Which organelle is known as the control center of the cell?
A) Cytoplasm
B) Cell wall
C) Nucleus
D) Chloroplast

steps: The nucleus directs cell activities and holds genetic material.

items.prompt:
Where does a cell release energy from food?
A) Mitochondria
B) Nucleus
C) Cell membrane
D) Cell wall

steps: Mitochondria carry out respiration to release energy from food.

items.prompt:
A cell has chloroplasts and a cell wall. This cell is most likely from a:
A) Human
B) Dog
C) Plant
D) Bacterium

steps: Chloroplasts and cell walls are found in plant cells.

items.prompt:
Which organelle allows a plant cell to make food using sunlight?
A) Mitochondria
B) Chloroplast
C) Nucleus
D) Vacuole

steps: Chloroplasts carry out photosynthesis using light energy.

items.prompt:
The organelles of a cell float in a jelly-like fluid called the:
A) Membrane
B) Cytoplasm
C) Nucleus
D) Vacuole

steps: Cytoplasm is the fluid that fills the cell and holds the organelles.

items.prompt:
A scientist finds a cell packed with mitochondria. What is the best inference about this cell?
A) It makes its own food from light
B) It uses a large amount of energy
C) It has no nucleus
D) It cannot divide
items.answer: B) It uses a large amount of energy

steps: Many mitochondria indicate a high energy demand, since mitochondria release energy.

items.prompt:
Which set lists parts found in a plant cell but NOT an animal cell?
A) Nucleus and membrane
B) Cell wall and chloroplasts
C) Cytoplasm and mitochondria
D) Membrane and nucleus

steps: Cell walls and chloroplasts are unique to plant cells; the others are in both.
